text.en: Clients speak very fondly of the store owners and customer service staff, noting their helpful guidance, knowledge of pet care, and warm demeanor. Many customers recount positive memories of staff guiding them through pet adoptions and offering continuous post-purchase advice. Reviewers also appreciate smooth, friendly assistance with dog licensing and pet supplies.

title.en: Happy pet stories with welfare note

text.en: Numerous long-standing customers share joyful accounts of raising healthy, well-adjusted puppies and kittens acquired through the shop over the years. However, one recent reviewer voiced serious alarm after noticing puppies and birds housed in warm shop enclosures with empty food bowls and room-temperature water, urging staff to ensure closer supervision of animals in the store.

Grooming feedback reflects varied customer experiences. Several recurring pet owners express high satisfaction with routine baths, nail trims, and haircuts for their dogs, returning regularly over many years. Conversely, one client reported a disappointing grooming outcome for their small dog, citing a botched cut that looked shaved down and strayed from explicit styling instructions.

q.en: Does Zoo-Rama Pet Shop offer pet grooming services?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that the store provides regular dog grooming and bath services, though haircut results receive varied feedback.

q.en: Can customers complete dog licensing at the shop?

a.en: Reviewers note that the staff assists pet owners with quick and simple municipal dog licensing procedures on-site.

q.en: What supplies and services are offered beyond grooming?

a.en: The shop sells specialty pet food, treats, accessories, and pet care packages, and provides routine advice on puppy transition and diet.
